title: Quietly Quenched Moroccan Lamb Mechoui
description: A romantic Moroccan dish featuring lamb mechoui with a sour and springy flavor profile, perfect for a quiet dinner, this high protein friendly meal combines panang curry paste with shio koji cure in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together panang curry paste, shio koji, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the lamb to a dolsot stone bowl and roast in the preheated oven for 2.5 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
